name: Windows path check
author: friday-core
description: Checks one or more Windows paths for the problems that break installs and file tools: forbidden characters, reserved device names (CON, NUL, COM1), trailing dots or spaces, names over 255 characters, paths near the 260-character limit, protected folders (Program Files, Windows) and cloud-synced folders. Converts between C:\ and /mnt/c/ forms and suggests a fixed name. Text only: it never touches the disk.
